label: preparing
what: A jubilee celebration for my forty years as mayor, apparently presented initially as an eighteen-hundred inspection of twelve new great-hall lanterns. Baker, innkeeper and builder are coordinating a large bread supply for the hall (apparently 200 loaves: 152 delivered and 48 awaiting ingredients). Freight is seeking the remaining sixteen hay bales, and the secretary coordinates reports and scheduling. My journal also connects the neighbour's tea with learning of the jubilee, though the neighbour's precise organizational role is less certain. I now know of the jubilee, but its coordinated preparations were initially not disclosed.
